answer: Copying an answer thus yields nothing, and producing 87 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the falcon ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the knoll review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the yarrow gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
